customers_say: Customers find the water purification unit to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its installation, taste, and water quality. However, the reliability and durability receive mixed reviews - while some say it works well, others report it stops working after 4 months and won't last more than a year. The value for money and water wastage aspects also draw mixed reactions, with some finding it worth the price while others say it's not budget-friendly and the zero-wastage feature is a gimmick.

reviews.author: Yashgunjal
reviews.title: Excellent water purifier
reviews.body: KENT Marvel Water Purifier Review ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ Excellent water purification with RO + UF + TDS Control and UV protection. The 8L storage capacity is suitable for family use, and the water taste is good. However, maintenance costs and water wastage should be considered before buying. Overall, a good option for high-TDS water if after-sales service is reliable.
